title: Harness Descriptor
description: The data half of a harness adapter: every declarative value a harness exposes, plus references to named code capabilities (transcript parsers, slug generation, shadow preflight). The write guard is pure data (the [guard] block) rendered by one generic engine. Authored as TOML (harnesses/*.toml), validated after transcoding to JSON. Cross-field invariants (guard/banner lockstep, slug/naming-rule agreement, vocabulary coverage, guard template contracts) are enforced by the Rust loader on top of this schema.

label.description: Kebab-case harness identifier, used in CLI flags, dispatch.json, and staged conditions.json.

skills_dir.description: Project-local staged-skills directory, `/`-separated relative to the repo root (e.g. ".claude/skills"). Optional: a harness without one cannot stage skills natively, so runs fall back to --no-stage (each SKILL.md inlined into its dispatch prompt) with a preflight warning.

config_dirs.description: Harness-owned config directory names (e.g. ".claude"). Feeds the staging sibling filter, guard tamper rules, and stray-write lookbehind.

run.description: Run-option capabilities; absent fields take the baseline defaults (no guard, bootstrap and stage-name allowed without staging).

tools.description: Tool-name vocabulary by role, as the harness's transcripts and hook payloads spell them.

staging.description: Native skill staging: slug shape (template or named capability), naming rules, and prompt phrasing.

slug_template.description: Staged-slug format with {prefix}/{iteration}/{condition}/{skill_name} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with slug_capability.

slug_capability.description: Named code capability generating the staged slug (sanitization/truncation beyond a format string).

stage_name_pattern.description: Regex a stage name must fully match (declarative validate_stage_name).

stage_name_invalid_message.description: Rejection message; {name} is substituted with the offending stage name.

skills_block.description: Harness-native available-skills block: header + one item per skill ({name}/{description}/{path} placeholders) + footer.

transcript.description: Transcript ingest: the events file the CLI dispatch captures and the named parser that reads it.

surfaces_skill_invocation.description: Whether the transcript deterministically surfaces a skill invocation (false routes the meta-check to the LLM-judge fallback).

guard.description: Write guard: the data the generic guard engine renders into a PreToolUse hook and a deny verdict. Restricted to embedded built-in descriptors (the guard fails open, so a mistyped user descriptor would silently disarm it).

hooks_file.description: Hook-config file the entry is merged into, `/`-separated relative to the staged env root (e.g. ".claude/settings.local.json").

matcher.description: Tool-name matcher the hook registers for; every hooked tool must be declared in [tools] write/patch/shell.

command_template.description: Shell command the armed hook runs, with {exe} and {marker} placeholders (e.g. '"{exe}" guard "{marker}"').

hook_entry.description: JSON template of the hook entry appended to the hook config's hooks.PreToolUse array, with {matcher} and {command} placeholders in its string values; authored key order is written verbatim.

verdict_template.description: JSON template of the deny verdict printed on stdout, with a {reason} placeholder; authored key order is the harness's on-disk contract.

dispatch.description: CLI dispatch guidance: command templates ({model_arg}/{guard_args} slots) and the prose around them.

capture_prefix.description: Prefix naming the judge recipe's per-task capture files ($response_base.<prefix>-events.jsonl).

guard_args.description: Extra args spliced into command templates at {guard_args} when the run is guarded (leading space included).

model_note.description: Sentence spliced into next_steps_template at {model_note} when an agent model was declared.

exec_template.description: Copy/pasteable single-dispatch command; <eval-root>-style angle placeholders are prose for the human.

parallel_command_template.description: Per-task command block spliced into the shared jq/xargs parallel scaffold.

judge_command_template.description: Judge command line spliced into the shared judge recipe; must reference $model_arg and {cwd} and end with a shell line continuation.

manifest_template.description: The dispatch-manifest harness section; {exec_command}/{parallel_recipe} placeholders; ends with exactly one newline.
